statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC s.302 (case initially registered under IPC s.307)
statutory_provisions.quote: a case No. 63/89 was registered for an offence punishable under Section 307 IPC... The criminal case was converted under Section 302 IPC.
statutory_provisions.reason: IPC s.302 and s.307 are right, but Evidence Act s.32 was only a rule of evidence, not a charged section.
